extra_quotes: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy measurements of the six c-GaN samples specified in Tab. 1 are carried out in reflection geometry using a TDS system with mechanical delay line at a rate of 50 Hz according to the setup shown in Fig. 1.

Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) measurements of the samples are executed in advance of the TDS investigation aiming to determine the layer thicknesses of both the c-GaN and the 3C-SiC layers.
In this heat map, it becomes obvious that samples S1 and S2 are outside the range, terahertz TDS is sensitive in.
